observation: The checked-in config comparison matrix did not match the deterministic generator on the audited origin/main baseline.
method: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/architecture -k "config or schema or dq"
expected: python -m scripts.schema generate-config-matrix --check exits 0 and the architecture drift test passes.
actual: Before remediation the drift test exited 1 with a matrix mismatch; after canonical regeneration both the generator check and focused drift test exit 0.
impact: The stale derived artifact made config governance evidence non-reproducible and caused the architecture drift gate to fail.

evidence.observation: The guard failed before remediation and passes after canonical regeneration.

root_cause: Unspecified; the derived matrix had not been refreshed after the current config surface changed.
remediation: Applied the canonical generate-config-matrix --update command and retained the blocking drift guard.
